properties.name: llmrix.model.router.http.enabled
properties.description: Enables the OpenAI-compatible HTTP and SSE endpoints.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.http.auth.mode
properties.description: HTTP authentication mode: api-key or none.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.http.auth.bootstrap-key
properties.description: Bootstrap Bearer key used by the default HTTP verifier.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.routes.*.strategy
properties.description: Routing strategy ID for this route.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.routes.*.models
properties.description: Ordered model references available to this route.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.routes.*.models[].integration
properties.description: Integration ID containing the routed model.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.base-url
properties.description: Provider API base URL shared by all models in the integration.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.api-key
properties.description: Provider credential passed to the configured authenticator.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.models
properties.description: Models exposed by this provider integration. Each item must define a unique name.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.models[].capabilities
properties.description: Capabilities implemented by the provider model.
